facets.medium: 黑色手绘线 + 马卡龙色块

source.notes: 压缩成正面描述；色号只留在 palette.colors，不写进提示词 C31@r4 锚点改由同题 q3 图解样例生成无具体内容的画风板，以免 q1 人物画风拉偏讲解图。

essence: 暖奶油色纸底，带细纸纹
线条、箭头、小涂鸦与文字都是黑色手绘线
信息放在圆角马卡龙浅色块里
只有一两处珊瑚红强调
清爽留白，像手绘概念图幻灯片

recipe.positive: Hand-drawn educational sketch-note infographic on warm cream paper with a subtle matte paper grain. Every outline, arrow and doodle is drawn in black hand-drawn ink lines with a friendly, slightly imperfect wobble. Information sits in rounded soft pastel blocks in light blue, mint green, lavender and peach, with one coral-red accent for one or two emphasis points only. Neat, airy layout like a hand-drawn concept diagram on a presentation slide: small simple doodles, clear sections, generous empty space, easy to understand at a glance. People, animals, objects and whole scenes are drawn the same way: simple flat doodles with black hand-drawn outlines and flat pastel fills on the cream paper, never painted or shaded.
recipe.text_style: Titles and labels are bold handwritten-style black lettering drawn by the same pen as the doodles, placed directly on the paper or inside the pastel blocks.

colors.name: 珊瑚红 coral red
colors.role: One or two emphasis points only

must_see: warm cream paper background with a subtle paper grain
outlines, arrows and doodles are black hand-drawn ink lines with a slight wobble
information grouped in rounded soft pastel blocks
flat hand-drawn look with simple fills, no painterly rendering or 3D shading
must_not_see: dense, cluttered layout with small unreadable elements
text in a typed or corporate font instead of handwritten lettering
when_text: information grouped in rounded soft pastel blocks
text in a typed or corporate font instead of handwritten lettering

drifts.symptom: 人物与场景题画成普通彩色插画，手绘笔记感变弱
drifts.fix: 本样式用于讲道理；讲故事的内容换故事类样式
